strongest_angle: Academic institutions are rapidly expanding their philosophy departments to address the existential and ethical implications of artificial intelligence.

key_facts.fact: Washington University in St. Louis (WashU) has launched a cluster hiring campaign to employ over 30 new tenure-track faculty members by 2029.
In 2013, only 1 percent of job roles listed on the academic platform PhilJobs were focused on philosophy of artificial intelligence.
Inside Higher Ed reports that universities are experiencing an exploding demand for philosophy professors capable of investigating the nature of knowledge and humanity in the age of AI.
